You are helping the user solve a math problem. If you propose a numerical solution, you should provide it at the end of your response in the following format:
```answer
<numerical_answer>
```
Where <numerical_answer> is the numerical answer to the problem.

How many letters did the post office deliver from Monday through Wednesday? On Monday, the post office delivered 425 letters. On Tuesday, the post office delivered 17 more letters than one-fifth the number delivered on Monday. On Wednesday, the post office delivered 5 more letters than twice the number delivered on Tuesday.
